notes: Yaroslav 2026-11-16: 60 for a 20-wave run (was 20 for one field). How much line damage the defence can take before the run is lost.
Defenders placed or moved during a round run in at this many times the speed of a regular soldier (Yaroslav, 2026-11-05).
Evade mode: route cost is travel time plus this many seconds per metre (rules/attackers.json).
Safest mode: one point of expected damage on the route counts as this many metres (rules/attackers.json).
Attackers' memory of a defender position fades by this share every wave it is not seen again (rules/attackers.json).
Proposal. A remembered position weaker than this is forgotten (about four waves without a new sighting).
Proposal. With threats known attackers pick a random entry among those at most 10% worse than the best one.
Proposal. A carrier destroyed while troops are still inside or getting out kills attacking troops within its blast_radius_m.

Decided by Yaroslav 2026-11-06: shared vision for both sides; every unit fires at what any friendly unit sees, out to its own range_m. TRUE would limit direct fire to what the shooter itself sees (kept as a switch for tests).
Proposal. Drones in the air are lost when their operator dies.
Proposal. Shooters lead a moving target by its speed times the round's flight time, misjudging the speed by this share (standard deviation).
Proposal. Height bomber drones drop grenades from (the grenade falls drone_altitude_m / projectile_speed_mps seconds).
Proposal. When guidance fails (ATGM, FPV: chance 1 - accuracy) the round lands 0.5 to 1.5 times this far from the target.

Proposal. A target that is only partly seen (seen chance below 1, e.g. in a forest belt): with chance 1 - seen the shooter aims at a guess this far off (standard deviation), so concealment still protects at close range.
Proposal (Yaroslav: a 30-40 m zone with rings). Area fire with spread_m (mortar): share of rounds landing in each equally wide ring of the zone, inner to outer; uniform inside a ring.
Proposal. How long an enemy spotter (recon UAV) stays over its spot (40% down the field) before flying out.
Proposal. Aircraft weave and change speed: anyone shooting at one aims about this far off (standard deviation). With hit_radius_m 0.2 an FPV is then hard to hit with a rifle.
Yaroslav 2026-11-16: rifle squad = 100, two of them at the start.
Proposal (economy test, 2026-11-16). Money added after each wave the defence holds, on top of kill rewards.
Proposal (playtest, 2026-11-16). Share of build_cost given back when a defender is removed.
Yaroslav 2026-11-17: defenders can stand anywhere on the field (was 0.35: only from 35% of the depth down).
Yaroslav 2026-11-16 (economy test, variant B): share of an attacker's reward_value (or threat_value) paid for killing it, when the wave is held.

Yaroslav 2026-11-17: a shooter fires at what its side sees only with a clear line to the target; behind a forest belt the recon drone's spotting is not enough. Mortar (indirect) and shots at aircraft and drones are exempt.
Yaroslav 2026-11-17: closed strips this wide along the left and right edges; nobody walks, drives or stands there, so units do not hug the edge of the screen.

Yaroslav 2026-11-17 (formations): assault line, how wide infantry spreads across its route, metres. Attackers form a line when every way crosses a defence they know (route mode Safest); otherwise they move in a column.
Assault line: how wide vehicles spread across the route, metres.
Assault line: speed multiplier (moving in bounds, covering each other).
Column: infantry steps up to this far beside the route so they do not walk inside each other; vehicles keep to it.

Yaroslav 2026-11-17: direct fire is held while one of the shooter's own side stands within this many metres of the line of fire, between them (a column shoots with its front only). Mortar and shots at aircraft and drones are exempt. Both sides.

Yaroslav 2026-11-17: a trench the player digs is a round firing position this many metres across from its middle; whoever stands in it (either side) has trench cover. Price: obstacles trench build_cost.
